The '''Sparker''', as it was nicknamed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] produced by the [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Sparkers dealt almost no damage to enemy ships' hulls, but rapidly eliminated the target's shields and disabled systems. Inaccurate at long range and possessing a slow rate of fire, Sparkers only had a moderate energy consumption rate.<ref name="Starfighter" />
